items.raw_excerpt: DCP Shruti N.S. encourages youth to practice meditation for better focus and to overcome substance addiction during a program launch.
items.summary_en: A police deputy commissioner in Hubballi-Dharwad told young people to practice meditation. She said it helps improve focus and can help overcome drug addiction. She spoke at the launch of a new program.
items.summary_ko: 후불리다르와드의 경찰 간부가 젊은이들에게 명상 연습을 권했다. 명상은 집중력을 높이고 마약 중독을 이기는 데 도움이 된다고 했다. 이 말은 새 프로그램 시작 행사에서 나왔다.
items.title_en: Police chief urges youth to try meditation
items.title_ko: 경찰 간부가 청년들에게 명상 시도 권해
items.title_original: Practice meditation to control your mind, says Hubballi-Dharwad DCP

items.raw_excerpt: 隨著擴增實境 (AR) 技術與城市觀光的結合日益緊密，Niantic旗下的長青手遊《Pokémon GO》再度選擇台灣作為大型實體活動的落腳點。繼過往與多個城市的合作經驗後，官方宣佈從2月20日起一連三天，在台南都會公園及奇美博物館園區舉辦「Pokémon GO Tour：卡洛斯－台南」。
items.summary_en: Niantic will hold the Pokémon GO Tour: Kalos event in Tainan, Taiwan. It runs for three days starting February 20 at Tainan Metropolitan Park and the Chimei Museum. The event mixes augmented reality with city sightseeing.
items.summary_ko: 나이언틱이 타이완 타이난에서 포켓몬 GO 투어 '칼로스' 행사를 연다. 행사는 2월 20일부터 사흘간 타이난 도시 공원과 치메이 미술관에서 열린다. 증강현실을 도시 관광과 결합한 대형 실외 행사다.
items.title_en: Pokémon GO Tour comes to Tainan park for three days
items.title_ko: 포켓몬 GO 투어, 타이난 도시 공원에서 사흘간 열려
items.title_original: 跨越虛實邊界：Pokémon GO Tour「卡洛斯」台南登場，2/20起連三日點亮都會公園 - Yahoo新聞

items.raw_excerpt: Starting next school year, the Samora Correia School Group in Benavente will begin offering specialised music education—a program that has already attracted over 50 students.
items.summary_en: A school group in Samora Correia, Benavente, will start offering specialised music education from the next school year. The program has already attracted over 50 students.
items.summary_ko: 베나벤테의 사모라 코헤이아 학교군이 다음 학년도부터 전문 음악 교육을 제공한다. 이 프로그램에는 이미 학생 50여 명이 참여를 결정했다.

items.raw_excerpt: After spending much of her 22 years plowing fields on Green Island off eastern Taiwan, an aging water buffalo has been given a chance to rest at a retirement center in Yunlin County after being bought and relocated by an animal lover.
items.summary_en: A water buffalo spent 22 years plowing fields on Green Island off eastern Taiwan. An animal lover bought her and moved her to a retirement center in Yunlin County. Now the aging buffalo can rest there.
items.summary_ko: 대만 동쪽 그린 섬에서 22년 동안 밭을 갈아 온 늙은 물소가 새 보금자리를 찾았습니다. 동물을 사랑하는 사람이 물소를 사들여 윈린 현의 은퇴 보호소로 옮겨 줬습니다. 이제 이 물소는 그곳에서 편히 쉴 수 있게 됐습니다.
items.title_en: Aging Green Island water buffalo finds new home in Yunlin
items.title_ko: 22년간 밭을 갈아온 늙은 물소, 윈린 현에서 쉴 집을 찾다
items.title_original: Aging Green Island water buffalo finds new home in Yunlin

items.summary_en: A Coritiba player celebrating a goal fell straight into a tunnel next to the pitch. The goal was later disallowed. The awkward fall became the talk of the match.

items.raw_excerpt: On 8 August, Bons Sons brought music, culture and community to Cem Soldos, a small village near Tomar, Portugal.
items.summary_en: On 8 August, the Bons Sons festival brought music, culture and community to Cem Soldos, a small village near Tomar, Portugal. The festival has now reached its third day. Locals and visitors enjoy music in a quiet village setting.

items.raw_excerpt: Frosty the horse was rescued from a frozen Lehman Creek, near the resort village of Cochin. He came out alive, but with major injuries. Now, after long months of treatments and recovery, Frosty is thriving on his new farm with his new family.
items.summary_en: A horse named Frosty was rescued from a frozen creek near the village of Cochin in Saskatchewan. He was badly hurt, but after months of treatment he healed. Now Frosty is happy and healthy on a new farm with a new family.
items.summary_ko: 프로스티라는 말이 서스캐처원 주 코친 마을 근처 얼어붙은 개울에서 구조되었습니다. 심하게 다쳤지만 여러 달간 치료와 회복 끝에 건강을 되찾았습니다. 이제 프로스티는 새 농장에서 새 가족과 함께 행복하게 지내고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Horse rescued from frozen creek gets a second chance

items.title_original: Sask. horse gets 2nd chance at life after being rescued from frozen creek near Cochin

items.raw_excerpt: From one extreme to the other within months in this lovely Cornish spot
items.summary_en: A small village in Cornwall was called the wettest place in the UK after 55 straight days of rain. Now the same village is dealing with a heatwave. Locals say the change happened within a few months.
items.summary_ko: 콘월의 작은 마을이 55일 연속 비가 내려 영국에서 가장 비가 많이 온 곳으로 불렸습니다. 그런데 이제 같은 마을이 폭염을 겪고 있습니다. 주민들은 몇 달 만에 두 극단을 모두 경험했다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: UK village that had 55 days of rain now faces a heatwave
